dish_drainer_compound_2_top_hung.notes: ONE RACK, TWO MODULES, AND THE PAGE SAYS WHERE IT GOES: 'In compound wall units, the dish-drainer rack is fitted in the widest unit.' That is a rule about the INTERIOR of an asymmetric compound - 60+45, 60+90 - and it is why modules_mm is not decoration. Nothing draws the rack, so nothing acts on it yet; it is recorded with its page. NOTE the width restriction is ABSENT here while both simple positions carry it.
